description: A head coach's straight-up, against-the-spread and over/under record in a spot, across every team he coached since 1999: off a bye, as a favourite or underdog, home or road, by month, after a loss, in prime time, division games, in the playoffs, and head to head against another coach. Loose names work (Reid, McVay, Harbaugh); a shared last name picks the most recent coach and lists the other. Raw record first with n and a 95% interval, then the holds_up test (held-out seasons, false-discovery correction, shrunk estimate). For 'Reid off a bye', 'Andy Reid after a bye week ATS', 'Harbaugh as an underdog', 'Tomlin as a dog', 'Belichick vs Reid', 'McVay against Shanahan', 'coach vs coach record'.

coach.description: Head coach, e.g. Andy Reid, Reid, Sean McVay.

opponent_coach.description: Opposing head coach, for coach vs coach.
